newsitem.title: USA: Cole Taylor split off clears tax hurdle.
newsitem.headline: Cole Taylor split off clears tax hurdle.

text.p: Cole Taylor Financial Group Inc said Wednesday the Internal Revenue Service has ruled its planned split off of its bank unit to a group headed by the company's chairman would be a tax free transaction.
The receipt of the favorable tax ruling was a condition to the consummation of the proposed split off transaction, the company said.

The group headed by chairman Jeffrey Taylor and others in the Taylor family plans to operate the bank as a private company, while the public company will operate the Reliance Acceptance Corp automobile financing company.
